overview.en: Walter Reed was an American army physician who proved that yellow fever is transmitted by mosquitoes, enabling the control of one of the most devastating tropical diseases.

early_life.en: Born in Belroi, Virginia, he earned his medical degree at age seventeen and served as a military physician across the American frontier.

impact.en: His proof of mosquito transmission of yellow fever enabled the construction of the Panama Canal and saved millions of lives in tropical regions.

event.en: Led the Yellow Fever Board in Cuba to investigate disease transmission
Confirmed mosquito transmission of yellow fever through controlled experiments

description.en: Paper proving that Aedes aegypti mosquitoes transmit yellow fever

text.en: The prayer that has been mine for twenty years, that I might be permitted to do something to alleviate human suffering, has been granted.
